about: jellyfin/jellyfin:12.4, disposable container, observed 2026-11-05. Fixture: a 60 s 640x360 Matroska film with three chapters (Opening 0 s, Middle Part 20 s, one untitled at 45.5 s), the same file in a library per option setting. Values are as the server answered; tags and paths are of that run.

scheduledTask.Name: Extract Chapter Images
scheduledTask.note: daily at 20:00, for at most 4 hours

whenMade.EnableChapterImageExtraction=true, Extra: ImageTag on every chapter when the library scan had finished (about 40 s after creating the library)
whenMade.EnableChapterImageExtraction=true only: no ImageTag after the scan; after POST /ScheduledTasks/Running/{RefreshChapterImages id} (204), ImageTag on every chapter within 15 s

storedPictureSize: 640x360, the film's own; no resizing at extraction

GET /Items/{id}/Images/Chapter/0?tag=bog.note: the tag is not checked against the picture; it is only echoed and makes the response cacheable

GET /Items/{id}/Images/Chapter.note: the first picture, no index needed

jellyfinWeb: the details page lists chapter cards only when Chapters[0].ImageTag is set; each card asks for /Items/{id}/Images/Chapter/{n}?maxWidth=400&tag={tag}; a card is a button with data-positionticks and starts playback there (see chapters-12.4.json for the page and the player)
